notManual: Only the saves of PC games you added can be copied.

folder.holdsGame: That folder holds the game itself (pick the folder its saves are in).
folder.tooBroad: That folder is too broad to copy (pick the game’s own save folder).
folder.ownFolder: That folder is one of PlayOut’s own (pick the game’s own save folder).
folder.usedBy: That folder overlaps the save folder of {title}.
folder.link: That folder is a link or junction to another folder (pick the folder it points to).
folder.tooManyFiles: That folder holds more than {max} files, so it is not just saves.
folder.holdsPrograms: That folder holds programs (.exe or .dll files), so it is not just saves.
folder.tooLarge: That folder takes {size} MB, more than the {max} MB PlayOut copies.
folder.notPlain: Choose a plain folder on one of this PC's drives (not a network, device or stream path).
folder.holdsLink: That folder holds a link or junction ({name}): choose the real folder instead.
folder.missing: Save folder not found ({path}): choose it again.
folder.sameGame: {title} in your library is the same game and already copies its saves: clear its save folder first.

launch.conflict: The saves of {title} changed on this PC and in the Emulation folder since they were last copied. Choose which to keep.
launch.gone: The saves of {title} are gone from this PC. Restore them from the Emulation folder, or start fresh.
launch.confirm: The Emulation folder has saves {machine} copied for a game with the same name ({title}). Use them?
